mapper.select: SELECT a.announcement_id, a.title, a.field_code, c.code_name AS field_name, a.total_budget, a.max_grant, a.start_date, a.end_date, a.content, a.status, a.view_count, a.writer_id, u.user_name AS writer_name, a.created_at FROM announcement a LEFT JOIN com_code_detail c ON a.field_code = c.code_id AND c.group_id = 'FIELD' LEFT JOIN users u ON a.writer_id = u.user_id WHERE a.announcement_id = #{announcementId}
mapper.update: UPDATE announcement SET title = #{title}, field_code = #{fieldCode}, total_budget = #{totalBudget}, max_grant = #{maxGrant}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, content = #{content}, status = #{status} WHERE announcement_id = #{announcementId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM announcement WHERE status = 'OPEN'
